description: This file implements the FilesystemCache class for Twig, a templating engine. It handles caching template files on the filesystem, including generating cache keys, loading, writing, removing cache files, and invalidating bytecode.

classes.name: FilesystemCache
classes.description: Implements a filesystem-based cache for Twig templates, providing methods to generate cache keys, load, write, remove, and check timestamps of cache files, with support for bytecode invalidation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a directory path and options.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Creates a cache file path based on the template name and class name, using hashing.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Includes the cache PHP file if it exists.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes content to a cache file, creating directories as needed, and invalidates bytecode if configured.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes the cache file corresponding to a given cache key.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the modification time of a cache file.
